name: Kumakawa Yuki
source:
"A slightly shy, gentle housewife"

At her husband’s suggestion, she decided to take yoga classes to become a little more outgoing. Her relationship with her husband is excellent, and their sex life is pretty good.

However, she has a strong sex drive, so that alone isn’t enough to satisfy her. In fact, she's quite the masturbator, and often masturbates next to her husband after he has fallen asleep.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/yoga/chara.html]official site[/url]]
